package tmuxgate

import "os/exec"

var denied = []string{"new-session", "kill-server", "-A", "-g"}

func binary() string { p, _ := exec.LookPath("tmux"); return p }

func Run(path string, a ...string) error { return exec.Command(binary(), append([]string{"-N", "-S", path}, a...)...).Run() }
